Specification: This module defines utility operators for finite zero-indexed sequences represented as functions with domain 0..(n-1). It provides constructors and conversions between ordinary one-indexed TLA+ sequences and this zero-indexed representation, along with derived operators for length, valid indices, rotations, and a lexicographic order. The module is a pure mathematical helper library with no state variables, no transition system, no fault model, and no temporal verification properties; its notable design choice is to represent zero-indexed sequences explicitly as functions rather than using the built-in Sequences indexing convention.
IfThenElse: IF s = EmptyZSeq THEN {} ELSE DOMAIN s
IF s = EmptyZSeq THEN 0 ELSE Cardinality(DOMAIN s)
IF seq = <<>> THEN EmptyZSeq ELSE [i \in 0..(Len(seq)-1) |-> seq[i+1]]
IF zseq = EmptyZSeq THEN <<>> ELSE [i \in 1..ZLen(zseq) |-> zseq[i-1]]
IF s = EmptyZSeq THEN EmptyZSeq ELSE [i \in ZIndices(s) |-> s[(i + r) % ZLen(s)]]
IF s = EmptyZSeq THEN {} ELSE {[ shift |-> r, seq   |-> Rotation(s, r) ] : r \in ZIndices(s)}
CaseExpr: CASE i = s1len \/ i = s2len -> s1len <= s2len [] s1[i] < s2[i] -> TRUE [] s1[i] > s2[i] -> FALSE [] OTHER -> IsLexLeq(s1, s2, i + 1)
SetEnumeration: {[ shift |-> r, seq   |-> Rotation(s, r) ] : r \in ZIndices(s)}
